what.name: Study
what.value_plain: Fabio v3, price-only parts: Model C (first-30-minute breakout) and Model B (failed breakout), BTCUSDT, NY window: BTC / USDT, Fabio v3 price-only: in the 390-minute window from the New York open the range of the first 30 minutes is the box; at the first 1-minute close beyond its edge (push test: off, m 15) go that way, market entry at the next candle, one try per day, no entry after open+329 min, stop at the box middle (floor 0.5 % of entry, dropped if wider than 1 %); exit at no target (held to the end of the window), or at the end of the window; fees 0.02 % limit / 0.05 % market, plus 0.02 % slippage on market and stop fills; 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30, development window only. Models A and D, the big-trade push, absorption and order-flow exits need data that starts 2024-12 and are not here.
what.label: OURS

how: export_trades.py replays every filled trade of the desk run from its own ref (same bars, same code, same fees) and lists entry, stop, target and exit as percent from the fill, signed in the trade's favour; net R is after fees.
window: DEV only, 2022-04-01 to 2024-06-30 (VALIDATION and HOLDOUT never offered)
why: 95 % range of the average -0.135 to +0.268 R: too wide to call either way; 518 trades can only rule out edges above about +0.29 R
